newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nearby soymeal in Europe trades firmer on tightnes.
newsitem.headline: Nearby soymeal in Europe trades firmer on tightnes.

text.p: Soymeal in Europe continue to trade firmer on tight nearby supplies, while most other products remained calm, market sources said.

"The situation of little unsold material coming from South America and crushers in Europe not running on full capacity due to the later than usual arrival of beans fron North America because of a late harvest this year caused prompt material to make a premium of close to $20 over December," one broker said.
At the beginning of November Afloat and December of Argentine soymeal pellets were quoted at around the same levels.
